thread:
Alex Kim: thought — what if console SLO cards had a small 'risk slider' that previews alert traffic if you loosen/tighten thresholds? could help PMs.
Diego Alvarez: like delta preview? eg +10% threshold -> estimate change in notify volume. how to compute cheaply though.
Alex Kim: sample last 14 days, compute count of events crossing candidate thresholds, extrapolate. show a small uncertainty band.
Priya Nair: add an expected cost impact line (approx $/day) so users see real trade-offs. also show suggested mitigation: group-by entity, add per-entity throttle.
Tom Becker: API implications: new endpoint sounds best: GET /routes/:id/slo_delta?threshold=0.9&window=14d
response proto: {"delta_estimate": "-320","expected_cost_change": "-\$12/day","confidence": "0.8"}
Diego Alvarez: 🛑 need to clarify if these numbers include external integration fanout. PD/SMS/Email spikes are expensive.
Riley (telemetry): include two columns — internal_delivery_estimate and integration_fanout_estimate (apply integration multipliers). we'll compute multipliers per-integration.
Alex Kim: UX: compact card shows current SLO, current notify/day, and a small graph showing projected notify under slider. clicking expands breakdown by tenant-size buckets.
Priya Nair: can we also surface a "sensitivity" metric: how many events are within X% of the threshold? helpful to know if small change flips many alerts.
Tom Becker: good idea. add sensitivity: percentage_of_events_in_band. API sketch addition.
Alex Kim: rollout idea: quick 'simulate' mode that applies changes to a simulated fanout engine for 24h and shows synthetic alert stream. no real notifications sent.
Diego Alvarez: simulate mode is safer than immediate canary. but customers will eventually want canary (apply to 5-10% tenants). both needed.
Priya Nair: console should surface recommended quick fixes: quiet-window suggestions, aggregate-by suggestions, or apply per-entity rate limits. each suggestion should have an estimated impact and a one-click 'apply to canary' action.
Riley (telemetry): compute cost: sampled pipeline + simulation step. we can cap sample size by default and allow tenants with very high volume to request longer windows off-peak.
Alex Kim: privacy/Private deployment: default preview disabled unless customer opts-in or SE enables; must not upload raw events to hosted telemetry.
Tom Becker: note for RFC: store only aggregated preview metrics, not raw logs. also add rate-limits on preview endpoint and quota billing note.
Priya Nair: copy for tooltip: "Estimates are based on sampled data and heuristics. Use simulate or a small canary to validate before applying globally." :information_source:
Diego Alvarez: should we expose an 'explain' link that returns top contributing entities that would be affected? helps troubleshooting.
Riley (telemetry): yes, but must be limited to top N and hashed identifiers for privacy. we can return anonymized buckets (e.g., bucket_1: 42 events).
Alex Kim: ok action items: Tom write RFC with API + privacy notes; Riley prototype sampling + sensitivity; Priya mock UI + slider/tooltip; Diego simulate engine design.
ops-bot: scheduled test deploy: slo-risk-slider-sim -> staging on 2024-12-02T09:30:00Z
Alex Kim: thanks all — sync on Monday design review? :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: added to calendar.
Tom Becker: will start RFC draft today.
Diego Alvarez: starting simulation design now.
Riley (telemetry): I'll share initial perf numbers once prototype runs.
